`v0.11.0` makes future updates much smaller, fixes Chinese input methods and a sound menu freeze, and finishes the Korean translation.

This update still downloads the full Omarchy system image (about 1.9 GB) one last time. Updates after this one skip it.

# Features

* Updates no longer download the full Omarchy system image. It is only fetched when you install Omarchy or choose **Start fresh**, and an interrupted download resumes where it left off (#312)
* Backups can leave out the system image, and backups to exFAT drives work (#312)
* Korean now covers the whole launcher (#318)
* Simplified Chinese wording is polished and covers the tray messages (#327)

# Fixes

* Fix typing and shortcuts not reaching Omarchy while a Windows input method such as Microsoft Pinyin is in Chinese mode (#328)
* Fix the sound menu freezing Omarchy when Windows has no microphone. Connecting a headset later picks up its microphone (#332)
* Fix volume sync stopping after choosing **VirtIO PCM 0** in Omarchy's sound menu. Omarchy now switches back to the Windows device (#277)
* Show a tray message when the Omarchy system update cannot be downloaded, instead of failing silently (#277)

## Dev

* Build runtime r23 with the input method and microphone fixes (#334, #338)
* Record volume sync state in diagnostics (#329)
* Fix a flaky clipboard test on Windows (#337)
* Add a security policy (#331)
